headline: MW4 DMZ is back in Korea
title: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ Is Back | New Map Hajin in Korea | Call of Duty News
video_script: DMZ is back in Call of Duty Modern Warfare four. This time it is set in Hajin, a fictional part of the demilitarized zone between North and South Korea. Squads drop in, take on story missions and extract with their loot. Critics praised its progression and missions. Are you playing DMZ or multiplayer? Comment below!
description: DMZ returns in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, set in Hajin, a fictional area of the Korean Demilitarized Zone.
